job.name: bot_avatar_textvideo
job.prompt: Square avatar for a Telegram bot that receives client requests for «ИИаватар» — a service that turns text into video. Deep black background #0E0E0E, white, one acid lime-yellow accent #D7F23C. Strictly centred composition, all inside the central 70% (cropped to a circle). A minimal flat vector symbol of the idea «text → video»: a white chat/message bubble with three short horizontal text lines (abstract lines, not letters) that morphs on its right side into a lime-yellow play-triangle. One single cohesive mark. Crisp, modern, premium, high contrast, readable at 64 px. NO text, no letters at all.
job.meaning: аватарка бота заявок ИИаватар без текста: белое облачко сообщения, переходящее в лаймовый треугольник play (текст → видео), чёрный фон
